note: The malformed HEIF metadata makes libheif return an error whose message pointer refers to storage owned by the libheif context/error buffer.
The parser error path is selected for the crafted input.
The libheif context is freed before the caller finishes using err.message, invalidating the message pointer returned in the heif_error structure.
Destroying the context releases ErrorBuffer string storage that can back the heif_error message pointer.
Qt logging converts err.message with QString::fromUtf8/strlen after the backing allocation has been freed, producing the ASAN heap-use-after-free read.
